name: Virgo — dark matter searches
summary: The Italian Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer, participating in an ultralight dark-photon search using actual O3 data.
detection_principle: Dark photons coupled to baryons or neutrons in the instrument can move its mirrors; strain channels are searched for narrowband excesses with a dark-matter linewidth.

key_parameters.name: Representative analysis in this record
key_parameters.value: O3 data from Advanced LIGO and Advanced Virgo

results.summary: The joint analysis found no dark-photon signal and set upper limits on coupling to ordinary matter.

science_scope: The representative result in this record is a search for direct coupling of ultralight fields to the instrument. Virgo also participates in gravitational-wave astronomy and astronomical dark-matter-candidate studies; LVK authorship does not imply all three facilities supplied data to every analysis.
